title: RayLink
description: ⚡ A high-performance, professional bridge connecting Minecraft and Discord 🎮 with secure account linking 🔗, immersive webhook chat, and full remote console control.
body:
# ⚡ RayLink — The Ultimate Minecraft ↔ Discord Bridge

RayLink is a fast, modern, all-in-one plugin that seamlessly connects your Minecraft server with Discord. It replaces multiple plugins like DiscordSRV, console bots, and whitelist managers with a single lightweight system.

**⚠️ Note: RayLink Required [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) to Work!**


### ✨ Key Features
- 🔗 Secure account linking with /link (Minecraft ↔ Discord)
- 💬 Advanced chat sync with webhooks and player avatars
- 🛡️ Interactive whitelist panel with buttons and logs
- 💻 Full console control through Discord slash commands
- 📊 Auto-rotating bot status (IP, TPS, Player Count)
- ⚙️ SQLite-backed data for speed and reliability

### 🛠️ Simple Setup
1. Place RayLink.jar in your plugins folder
2. Create a Discord bot and paste your token in config.yml
3. Add channel IDs and restart your server

### 🤖 Main Commands
- /link <code> — Link accounts
- /status — Server performance overview
- /whitelist-panel — Create whitelist UI
- /console <cmd> — Run console commands from Discord
